primary_goal: Build a scientifically validated, reproducible, autonomous and risk-controlled Trading Agent that, only after sufficient evidence and formal authorization, can generate sustainable realized-P&L cashflow that can support the user's family through variable withdrawals while preserving a defensible capital base.
success_condition: Robust reproducible out-of-sample and holdout evidence across formal gates before deployment consideration.
Later withdrawal logic based on realized P&L, with required reinvestment and risk reserves before withdrawal.
Full auditability through provenance, immutable reconciliation and durable evidence records.

financial_intent.withdrawal_basis: realized P&L after required reinvestment and risk reserves

operating_principles: More compute may accelerate research but may never relax scientific gates.
Historical capability receipts and current live resource availability must remain separate states.
Maximize useful continuous occupancy of free capacity without artificial work, duplicate work or runtime padding.
Persist durable goals, decisions, progress and continuity in canonical repository layers so subsequent chats can resume without relying on transcript memory.
source_of_truth_role: Defines project intent only. Technical truth remains current public master; scientific truth remains ledger, checkpoints and workflow evidence.
